cd /workspace/project && timeout 500 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
def ask(model,mt=400):
    b=json.dumps({"model":model,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Jelaskan kenapa langit biru, 3 kalimat."}],"max_tokens":mt}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    t0=time.time()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=180) as x: d=json.load(x)
    return d, time.time()-t0
print(f"{'MODEL':50} {'detik':>6} {'compl':>6} {'reason':>7} {'cost':>10}")
for m in ["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",

          "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored:thinking",
          "qwen/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored",
          "qwen/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored:thinking"]:
    try:
        d,el=ask(m); u=d['usage']; msg=d['choices'][0]['message']
        rl=len((msg.get('reasoning_content') or msg.get('reasoning') or ''))
        print(f"{m:50} {el:6.2f} {u['completion_tokens']:6} {rl:7} ${u['cost']:9.6f}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"{m:50} HTTP{e.code}")
